title: the missing-prerequisite path prints an install command but never runs one
titleZh: 缺前置件时只打印安装命令,绝不代跑
why: The remedy for a missing prerequisite is an interactive install that the collector must never perform. Two properties are asserted together: the blocked verdict with a printable remedy (checked in fault-tailscale-not-installed) and, on the human-readable path, that the reported action is text a person has to run. The suite also proves the negative statically in filescan-no-localized-hardmatch-and-ascii (no msiexec / Start-Process / runas anywhere) - this case is the runtime counterpart.
inject: fixture declares tools.tailscale absent, the run is rendered for a human instead of as JSON
expectSummary: exit 2, stdout shows the blocked item, names Tailscale, and mentions installing it by hand
